work.text: His next subject was a much more magnificent one, but too vast and varied perhaps — the repulse and defeat of the Spanish floating batteries at Gibraltar.

moment.text: Copley was sent to Hanover to take the portraits of four of the generals of that country, who, with those of England, had won their laurels on that sea-washed "Rock."
